name: GNU Arm Embedded Toolchain
description: Native GNU Arm Embedded 10.3-2021.10 and GNU Arm 14.3.rel1 compilers, assembler and linker for Beken SDKs.
notes: 10.3.1 native aarch64 execution and Cortex-M33 compile/link were verified previously. The new 14.3.1 candidate pins byte-verified original Arm14.3.rel1 Linux aarch64/x86_64 archives and declares Cortex-M55/M52 compile/link checks; those binaries were not executed during registry validation. Its host runtime includes libzstd.so.1 for the upstream binutils/compiler binaries. Bundled GDB and optional debugger runtimes are outside compiler qualification; legacy 10.3.1 GDB needs additional Python2.7/ncurses libraries.
